items.name: portrait-neutral-hollow-stag
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: HOLLOW STAG, the sacred forest guardian: a slender deer head of pale bark with a cream muzzle and big dark eyes, crowned with a tall, wide spread of branching pale wooden antlers tipped with tiny yellow-green leaf buds, a mane of moss and leaves around its neck. Signature feature: the tall spreading branch antlers, the widest shape in the icon.

items.name: portrait-neutral-barkguard
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: BARKGUARD, the stag's hulking retinue: a heavy, low-set head with a cream deer-like face, big dark eyes and short, thick, stubby twig antlers, sunk between two massive hunched shoulders of brown bark armour with moss and leaf tufts. Signature feature: the huge bark shoulders rising either side of the head; the antlers stay short.

items.name: portrait-neutral-willow-wisp
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: WILLOW WISP, a willow spirit: a round pale cream face with two big glossy black eyes, framed by a curtain of long drooping yellow-green willow leaves hanging down like hair, two small curved twig antlers and a few white blossoms on top, a small acorn amulet at its chest. Signature feature: the hanging willow-leaf curtain.

items.name: portrait-neutral-bloom-witch
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: BLOOM WITCH, a thorn-grove caster: a dark brown wooden face with two pale white eyes, under a broad hat of pink-red flower petals with a pointed bark tip curling up, one white blossom at the brim, a collar of leaves. Signature feature: the wide pink petal hat.

items.name: portrait-neutral-briar-hulk
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: BRIAR HULK, a thorn-grove brute: a hulking face of twisted brown bark and vines with a deep-set scowl under a leaf-shaped cream bark brow, heavy shoulders of knotted roots and moss bristling with big pale thorn spikes. Signature feature: the pale thorn spikes on its shoulders and crown.

items.name: portrait-neutral-seedcaster
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: SEEDCASTER, a thorn-grove seed slinger: a slender pale-gold wooden head shaped like a pointed seed with one dark eye slit, two small twig antlers sprouting leaves, a leafy collar hung with seed pods, and beside it the closed bud on top of its twig staff. Signature feature: the pointed seed-shaped head.

items.name: portrait-neutral-capling
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: CAPLING, a mushroom brawler: a chubby pale cream face with small dark eyes and a stubborn frown under a big tilted red-orange toadstool cap with white spots, a cluster of tiny tan mushrooms growing on the cap's top, a moss collar with white flowers. Signature feature: the spotted cap crowded with little mushrooms.

items.name: portrait-neutral-puffcap
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: PUFFCAP, a mushroom spore-thrower: a chubby pale cream face with small dark eyes under a smooth, round-domed red-orange toadstool cap with white spots, and held up beside it the round speckled cream puffball on top of its stick staff. Signature feature: the round puffball staff head.

items.name: portrait-neutral-violet-sporeling
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: VIOLET SPORELING, a corrupted spore creature: a small dark bark-brown face with glowing magenta-violet eyes peering from under a huge, broad, glossy magenta-violet mushroom cap, small violet shelf fungi on its shoulders and clawed root fingers. Signature feature: the huge magenta cap.

items.name: portrait-neutral-root-seer
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: ROOT SEER, a corrupted root caster: a long pale wooden mask face with one big glowing magenta-violet eye, crowned with forked branch antlers, magenta shelf fungi growing along its side, and beside it the top of its crooked staff curled around a violet orb. Signature feature: the single glowing eye in the long mask.

items.name: portrait-neutral-corrupted-rootbeast
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: CORRUPTED ROOTBEAST, a rotting root beast: a low, broad head of twisted tan roots with a snarling mouth of root fangs, a crown of jagged broken branch spikes, olive moss and glowing magenta-violet fungus caps sprouting through its bark. Signature feature: the jagged branch crown.

items.name: portrait-neutral-rotwood-ancient
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: ROTWOOD ANCIENT, the corrupted ancient: a towering rotten tree head of cracked tan bark with a deep hollow face, broken branch horns, and stacked shelf mushrooms of glossy magenta-violet growing over its brow and shoulders, olive moss in the cracks. Signature feature: the stacked magenta shelf mushrooms.

items.name: portrait-neutral-old-root
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: OLD ROOT, an ancient root spirit: an old wooden face with a deep-set brow and a long, thick beard of layered yellow-green leaves, tufts of leaves and twigs on its head, and beside it the spiral-curled top of its root staff. Signature feature: the long leaf beard.

items.name: portrait-neutral-rootling
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: ROOTLING, a little stump guardian: a squat tree-stump head of light bark with a split pale heartwood face, two small glowing amber eyes, a few fresh leaf sprouts on top, moss on its broad root shoulders. Signature feature: the stump-shaped head with sprouts.

items.name: portrait-neutral-twigcaster
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: TWIGCASTER, a twig spellcaster: a small round pale wooden face with two glowing amber eyes, two branching twig antlers tipped with leaves, a leafy shawl, and beside it the twig loop on top of its staff cradling one glowing pale-gold seed. Signature feature: the glowing seed in the twig loop.

items.name: portrait-neutral-dew-sprite
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: DEW SPRITE, a water spirit: a glossy translucent cyan water-drop head with a curling pointed tip on top, big dark teal eyes and a small smile, a sprig of leaves at the side of the drop, a leaf collar with one white blossom. Signature feature: the curled water-drop tip.

items.name: portrait-neutral-puddle-wisp
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: PUDDLE WISP, a water spirit: a round glossy translucent cyan water head with big dark eyes, wearing a pointed lime-green leaf as a hood with one big white blossom on it, a leaf collar with a wooden bead. Signature feature: the pointed leaf hood.

items.name: portrait-neutral-tadpole-spirit
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: TADPOLE SPIRIT, a pond spirit: a wide, round, glossy translucent cyan head with two huge dark glossy eyes, a crown of broad leaves on top and two brown cattail heads sticking up like antennae. Signature feature: the two cattail heads above the leaf crown.

items.name: portrait-neutral-tree-frog
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: TREE FROG, a pond hunter: a bright lime-green frog head with a cream throat, a brown stripe down its brow and two big bulging golden-orange eyes with black pupils, a wide closed mouth. Signature feature: the big bulging golden eyes.

items.name: portrait-neutral-young-toad
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: YOUNG TOAD, a pond hunter: a broad, warty olive-gold toad head with a wide grin and two round orange eyes, a tuft of leaves and two brown cattail heads on top, a pebble amulet on a vine at its throat. Signature feature: the wide, flat, grinning toad head.

items.name: portrait-neutral-hornet-guard
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: HORNET GUARD, a paper-nest guard: a heavy armoured hornet head of glossy yellow and dark brown chitin with big dark red-brown compound eyes, short thick yellow mandibles and two long curved antennae, a pointed yellow spike crest rising from its brown back plate behind the head. Signature feature: the spiked back crest. No wings.

items.name: portrait-neutral-needle-wasp
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: NEEDLE WASP, a paper-nest sniper: a narrow, slender wasp head of yellow and brown chitin with dark red-brown compound eyes and two very long antennae, one slim pale wing raised behind, and its long needle stinger curled forward under it, aimed at the lower left. Signature feature: the long needle stinger.

items.name: portrait-neutral-nest-mother
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: NEST MOTHER, the queen of the paper nest: a big, broad hornet head of yellow and dark brown chitin with large round dark compound eyes, a fluffy brown fur collar, two huge curved ivory mandibles, and two big translucent amber wings raised high behind her head. Signature feature: the huge ivory mandibles under the raised wings.

items.name: portrait-neutral-webling
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: WEBLING, a hungry little spider: a small round tan spider with a pale skull-like face, two huge round dark eyes and two short ivory fangs, moss and leaves on its back, the tips of stubby hairy legs at the bottom edge. Signature feature: the two huge round eyes.

items.name: portrait-neutral-spitter
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: SPITTER, the silk-spitting spider: a broad, squat spider head of brown bark-like chitin with a row of four small glossy red-brown eyes and two long curved ivory fangs, its humped back overgrown with moss, leaves and twigs. Signature feature: the row of eyes over the long fangs.

items.name: portrait-neutral-thorn-slinger
items.refnote: the first image is a small in-game render of this creature: keep its design, shapes and colours, but paint only its head and shoulders, larger, crisper and glossier; ignore its full-body pose.
items.subject: THORN SLINGER, a bramble mouse: a tan mouse head with two big round pink ears, big glossy black eyes, a pink nose and whiskers, a little crown of moss and leaves between the ears, a leafy collar, the strap of its sling over one shoulder. Signature feature: the big round pink ears.
